_comment: Taste memory per docs/11-collaboration.md. Written by the engine, read by every future session. Decisions are yours; measurements are mine.

rounds.subject: pistol 32x32
engine_findings: A fails: a 10px barrel band merges slide and grip into one brick; zero enclosed air means the trigger guard is not a loop
B has the correct barrel proportion (5px band) and the widest open air, but its guard is a hook, not a loop
C is the only option with a real guard loop (7px enclosed air) but its 6x13 grip reads as a stick, not a handle
synthesis proposed for round 2: B's barrel/grip proportions + C's guard loop

rejected_patterns_so_far.reason: merges barrel and grip into one mass
reads as a stick, not a handle

rejected_patterns_so_far.pattern: silhouette with zero enclosed air on a functional object

vocabulary.muddy: anti-aliasing or dither crossing hue families; ramp steps too close in value
vocabulary.busy: detail budget exceeded; lone pixels; texture clusters too dense
vocabulary.floats: missing contact shadow or anchor drift
vocabulary.hard to read: silhouette failure at squint scale; feature budget exceeded
